versions.subject: rule: kernel dump using dtrace
versions.detection:
selection_plain:
    Image|endswith: '\dtrace.exe'
    CommandLine|contains: 'lkd(0)'
selection_obfuscated:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
        - 'syscall:::return'
        - 'lkd('
condition: 1 of selection*
